title: Bring the AI you already pay for

captions.instagram:
Bring the AI you already pay for.

Install Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor in Terminal and sign in, exactly as its maker describes. rotli then talks to that tool directly on your Mac, the same way you would from Terminal.

rotli never signs in for you, never reads the tool's login files, and never stores its credentials. Prefer nothing leaving your Mac? Pick an on-device model.

rotli.co/features
captions.linkedin:
We didn't want rotli to sit between you and your AI provider.

So rotli uses each company's own published command-line tool. You install Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor in Terminal and sign in exactly as its maker describes; rotli then runs that tool on your Mac and passes it your message.

• rotli never signs in on your behalf, reads the tool's login files, or stores its credentials.
• Your plan is used the way its company intends: no workaround, no shared account.
• In the browser, Rotli Helper runs the same tools on your own computer.

Or skip all of it and use an on-device model. rotli.co/features
